sql.user.findByUsernameIgnoreCase: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, u.username, u.password, u.company_id, null as "timezone", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.user_status_type_id, c.aws_bucket from flow.user u inner join flow.company c on c.id = u.company_id where lower(username) = lower(:username)
sql.user.findByUserUuid: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, user_status_type_id from flow.user where uuid = :uuid
sql.user.findUserById: select u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.company_id, c.aws_bucket, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, u.user_status_type_id from flow.user u inner join flow.company c on c.id = u.company_id where u.id = :id
